principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix disparate disciplines.
Content is King: Data is the story.
Zoom In: Big, bold numbers for KPIs.
Negative Space: Breathing room between dense data.
Contrast: High contrast for readability and impact.
anti_patterns: Purple/Teal for CTAs (Use Electric Blue instead).
Inter everywhere (Use Barlow Condensed for Headings).

headings.usage: Page titles, Card headers, Big KPI numbers

mono.usage: Financial data, IDs, Dates, Code snippets

rules: Primary color (Electric Blue) ONLY for main CTAs.
Use 'Success Green' for Revenue and Active status.

strategies.lists: Full width tables with sticky headers.

cards.style: Flat background, 1px border (border-border), no shadow by default.

navigation.header: Sticky top, glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border/50).

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use for 'Subscription Plans' cards. A glowing gradient border that traces the edge.

login_background.alt: Abstract white and blue geometric shapes
login_background.usage: Login page left panel background, cover

empty_state.style: Use Lucide Icons (e.g., Box, Ghost) with large size (w-12 h-12) and muted colors.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Color: muted-foreground (default), primary (active).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is Slate 900 on White, or White on Blue 600.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install fonts: Barlow Condensed, Inter, JetBrains Mono.
2. Update tailwind.config.js with the 'Performance Pro' colors.
3. Create a 'Layout' component with Sidebar and Header.
4. Build the Dashboard using the Bento Grid Mode B.
5. Implement the 'Tracing Beam' effect for the Plans page.
6. Ensure all forms use Shadcn Form components.
8. STRICTLY follow the 'Anti-AI' design principles: No generic gradients, no 'Inter' for headings.
9. Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (generic centered layouts, purple gradients).
Do not center align the app container.
